data.one_liner: Compress pictures using native code to effectively reduce image size.
data.what_it_does: Compresses images using platform-native encoders on Android, iOS, macOS, Web, and OpenHarmony. Exposes methods for files, assets, and raw bytes, returning compressed bytes or files.
use_when: You need to reduce image file sizes before uploading them to a server.
Dart-based image compression libraries are too slow for your application workloads.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms or formats not supported by the native encoders without fallback handling.
strengths: Dramatically faster than Dart-only image compression libraries.
Supports multiple input types including files, asset images, and raw byte lists.
Provides controls for quality, dimensions, rotation, and EXIF metadata preservation.
weaknesses: Certain features and formats (like WebP or HEIC) have platform-specific caveats or lack full support.
Requires proper initialization when called from a background isolate.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package in your Dart code.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a pure Dart image processing library without native dependencies.
